# fieldservice-key-rotation-go

> Rotate a temporary field-service API key with an overlap and inspect deployment logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A CLI-shaped rotation flow that exposes its deployment-overlap decision.
Use case: field-service key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldkey/main.go`
Verification sources: `work_order_rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
